name: fonscape
description: Fonscape（风栖），一款清新、响应式、注重阅读体验的 React 个人博客主题模板。

DB.description: Stores runtime accounts, comments, sessions and rate-limit state; published blog content remains in Git.

ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Enter a long random one-time token. Leave no default value; the first administrator enters it on /#/admin/setup.

scripts.pnpm:devPreinstall: node scripts/generate-content-targets.mjs && node scripts/generate-font-css.mjs && node scripts/generate-responsive-images.mjs --manifest-only
scripts.predev: node scripts/generate-content-targets.mjs && node scripts/generate-font-css.mjs && node scripts/generate-responsive-images.mjs
scripts.prebuild: node scripts/generate-content-targets.mjs && node scripts/generate-font-css.mjs && node scripts/generate-responsive-images.mjs
scripts.pretest: node scripts/generate-content-targets.mjs && node scripts/generate-font-css.mjs && node scripts/generate-responsive-images.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && vite build && pnpm check:performance-budget
